camel_example: aliyun iqs POST /linked-retrieval/linked-retrieval-entry/v1/iqs/answer/omni/search --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"query":"今天杭州天气"}'
description_en: This topic describes the SearchStream streaming API for intelligent search and AI chat. Based on retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and large language models, this API accepts natural language questions from users and can automatically execute intent recognition, query rewrite, and content generation, and retrieve data from multiple sources. The API uses the Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming protocol to return data, supporting real-time output of the infer status, reference sources, and token-by-token generated answers. This API is suitable for AI chat and search scenarios that require low latency and high interpretability
description_zh: 本文档介绍智能搜索问答流式接口（SearchStream）。该接口基于检索增强生成（RAG）与大语言模型技术，接收用户自然语言问题后，自动执行意图识别、查询改写、多源检索与内容生成。接口采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 流式协议返回数据，支持实时输出推理状态、参考来源及逐字生成的答案，适用于对低延迟、高可解释性有要求的智能问答与搜索场景
